subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected macOS onboarding PR be closed as superseded by current main, or should any narrow pieces be rebased onto the current Crestodian and automatic Gateway setup flow?
rationale: The PR is protected by the `maintainer` label, overlaps merged maintainer-led onboarding work, and still has security/auth compatibility blockers that require owner direction before any salvage path is worth automating.

options.title: Close or supersede this branch
options.body: Treat current main plus narrower follow-up issues as the canonical onboarding direction and do not merge this stale branch wholesale.

options.title: Request a narrow rebase
options.body: Ask the author or an owner to rebase only the still-wanted UX pieces onto current main after fixing the security/auth blockers and adding real macOS proof.

options.title: Keep paused for product review
options.body: Leave the PR open under the protected label until macOS onboarding owners decide whether any part still belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Close or supersede this branch
recommendation.body: Treat current main plus narrower follow-up issues as the canonical onboarding direction and do not merge this stale branch wholesale.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main macOS onboarding direction was established by steipete's merged automatic Gateway and Crestodian onboarding work.
